∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (history : ℕ → MeasurableSpace Ω)
  (remaining : ℕ → Ω → Finset ℕ) (rows : ℕ → Ω → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow),
  (∀ (k : ℕ), history k ≤ inst) →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), Measurable (remaining k)) →
      (∀ (k : ℕ), Measurable (rows k)) →
        (∀ (k : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (rows k) ↑outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.rowLaw ↑P) →
          (∀ (k : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.Indep (history k) (MeasurableSpace.comap (rows k) inferInstance) ↑P) →
            outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.FreshAssignments P history remaining fun k ω =>
              (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.chooseRemaining (rows k ω)
                    ((remaining k ω).sort fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2)).getD
                0
